categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates as a semiconductor components distributor and agent, focusing on electronic components and computer peripheral equipment sales and technical services. It serves various application fields including industrial electronics, automotive electronics, mobile communications, consumer electronics, computer peripherals, AI, and 5G. The group also provides supply chain management and technical support services across Greater China, Southeast Asia, Mexico, and India.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company does not engage in manufacturing but emphasizes technical support and application engineering services (FAE/AE) to assist customers and upstream manufacturers in developing clean technology product solutions. It focuses on semiconductor components such as chipsets, mixed-signal, and discrete components, with R&D efforts in AI servers, 5G, AIoT, automotive electronics, power semiconductors, energy storage, and green energy applications. The company invests in digital solutions and green product development aligned with sustainability goals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in computer, communications, consumer electronics, industrial control, and automotive sectors. The company supports OBM, ODM, and OEM clients, providing components for AI servers, data centers, 5G infrastructure, electric vehicles, and green energy systems. Major markets served are Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, Southeast Asia, Mexico, and India.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Greater China (Taiwan, Hong Kong, China), Southeast Asia (Singapore, Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia), Mexico, and India. It maintains subsidiaries and offices in these regions to provide localized supply chain and technical support services, with logistics capabilities extending to the United States and other global locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions as a midstream semiconductor components distributor and agent, bridging upstream semiconductor manufacturers (IDM and fabless companies) and downstream electronic product manufacturers. It provides supply chain integration, technical support, and demand creation services, facilitating technology linkage and value creation between suppliers and customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding product portfolios with a focus on low-carbon and green energy semiconductor solutions, enhancing supply chain flexibility amid geopolitical uncertainties, and deepening technical support capabilities. R&D efforts target AI, 5G, AIoT, automotive electronics, power semiconductors, energy storage, and digital energy conversion. The company emphasizes sustainability, decarbonization, and green computing, investing in application engineering and digital tools to support customers' evolving needs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of semiconductor components and computer peripheral equipment as an authorized agent and distributor. The company also earns income from technical support services, supply chain management, and related value-added services. It does not manufacture products but focuses on sales commissions, service fees, and possibly licensing related to its distribution agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with several midstream semiconductor component distributors in Taiwan, including WPG Holdings, Avnet, Synnex, and others. It holds a stable position with a diversified product portfolio and strong upstream manufacturer relationships. Its demand creation capability and technical support services are recognized competitive advantages. Market share is smaller compared to the largest players but the company maintains a solid niche in the semiconductor distribution sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$89.67 billion, a 26.49% increase year-over-year, and pre-tax profit of NT$1.48 billion, up 41.04%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by strong demand in AI and semiconductor markets. It maintains a robust financial structure with total assets of NT$42.83 billion and equity of NT$10.91 billion, reflecting a growth trajectory aligned with industry expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its role as a professional semiconductor components agent providing comprehensive supply chain integration, technical support, and demand creation services. Its unique value lies in bridging upstream manufacturers and downstream customers with timely, flexible logistics and application engineering support. It focuses on sustainability and green technology solutions, enabling customers to meet decarbonization goals while maintaining competitive product offerings. The company’s strong regional presence and multi-brand portfolio further differentiate it in the semiconductor distribution market.
